chunks: Our father and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with them) narrated that Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Humayri narrated to me, Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ja'far ibn Bashir al-Bajali, from Dharih al-Muharibi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) covered Ali (peace be upon him) with a cloak, then taught him a thousand words.

key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّم: peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet teach Ali ibn Abi Talib under the cloak?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kisāl*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the unique spiritual status of Imam Ali by describing how the Prophet covered him with a cloak—a symbol of honor and protection—before imparting a thousand words of esoteric knowledge. This event underscores the Shia belief in the transmission of divine wisdom (*'ilm*) through the Ahl al-Bayt, linking Ali directly to the prophetic legacy and the deeper meanings of the Quran.
